name: Launch
rules: No business decision performed here

name: Welcome
purpose: Explain Mingo promise and let learner start
rules: No efficacy/mastery claim

name: Goal
rules: Goal cannot rewrite measured skill

name: Placement Offer
rules: Placement optional; missing evidence allowed

name: Placement Question
states: Ready, selected, validation-error, submitting, result, skipped-domain, audio-unavailable
rules: Placement response requires explicit selection/allowed domain skip; provisional only; listening play request is not score authority.

name: Placement Result
purpose: Show provisional starting state and uncertainty
rules: Qualitative/provisional language only

name: Home
purpose: Answer what to do next and why
rules: Reason copy must match logged reason; no risk/mastery percentage

name: Home Offline
purpose: Home with offline status and device-saved distinction
rules: Queued is not server-confirmed

name: Home Syncing
purpose: Show background synchronization without blocking navigation
rules: No duplicate progress/reward from retries

name: Learn Hub
purpose: Start or resume finite learning cycle
rules: No infinite feed

name: Cycle Intro
purpose: Show objective, reason and approximate duration
rules: ~5 min is configurable hypothesis; objective/reason explicit

name: Review Item
rules: Blank submit is impossible; Skip is explicit and creates no completion/mastery.

name: Learn Content
rules: Reading explanation alone is not mastery

name: Retrieve Item
states: Ready, selected, hinted, submitted-result, retry-available, retry-exhausted, skipped
rules: First response is preserved; assisted flag persists independently of feedback; one retry is the current configurable policy.

name: Transfer Item
rules: Blank submit is impossible; transfer is within objective and does not change level.

name: Check Intro
rules: No pre-submit hint in Check

name: Check Item
states: Ready, selected, validation-error, submitting, result, audio-ready, audio-unavailable, play-limit-reached
rules: No pre-submit hint; blank submit impossible; Check has no practice retry; listening play requests are client telemetry only.

name: Correct Feedback
rules: Reward/copy cannot imply validated mastery from one answer

name: Incorrect / Retry Feedback
purpose: Explain error and offer practice retry where policy allows
states: Retry available, retry used, retry exhausted
rules: Retry correct never overwrites first wrong

name: Hint Panel
rules: Hint use marks evidence assisted

name: Skip Confirmation
purpose: Confirm skip without shame or false completion
rules: Skip != completion/mastery/streak

name: Cycle Summary
purpose: Explicit closure, practiced evidence and next step
rules: No fake mastery %; user explicitly starts another cycle

name: Resume Cycle
rules: No duplicate submit on resume

name: Course Map
rules: Preview does not unlock/progress

name: Objective Detail
rules: Prerequisite guardrail remains authoritative

name: Locked Preview
rules: Preview cannot create evidence, progress, completion, prerequisite bypass or unlock.

name: Profile
purpose: Goal, qualitative learning evidence and settings entry
rules: Engagement/streak not presented as mastery

name: Evidence Detail
purpose: Show observations, uncertainty and missing evidence
rules: No diagnosis or precise mastery percentage without validated model

name: Goal Settings
rules: Goal change does not rewrite competence

name: Learning Preferences
rules: Preference cannot bypass required eligibility rules

name: Offline Downloads
rules: Access grant/package rules remain server-authoritative

name: Sync Queue
purpose: Explain queued/synced items without technical jargon
rules: Connectivity and server acknowledgement are distinct; Synced appears only after authoritative acknowledgement/canonical refresh.

name: Sync Error
rules: Recovery reuses durable command identity; local state never overwrites server truth.

name: Generic Error
rules: No false success state

name: Nothing Due / Content Gap
rules: Do not fabricate cycle/recommendation

name: Re-auth Required
rules: Phase 3 implements auth; no local permission bypass

name: Staff Entry
rules: Actual authentication/authorization belongs Phase 3

name: Dashboard
rules: Metrics must identify time range/source

name: Learner List
rules: Role visibility is not authorization

name: Learner Overview
rules: No mental-state diagnosis; raw risk not default to content admin

name: Learner Evidence
rules: Mastery != risk; uncertainty visible

name: Learner Activity
rules: Historical revision pinning preserved

name: Content Library
rules: Published revision immutable

name: Content Draft Editor
purpose: Author draft content and learning metadata
states: clean, dirty, saving, saved, validation-error, reviewer-changes
rules: Fields have programmatic labels; preview/save/review transitions are explicit; published bytes are never edited.

name: Content Preview
rules: Preview has no publish/progress side effect.

name: Source & License
rules: Publication stays blocked until provenance/license requirement passes.

name: Review Queue
rules: Reviewer actions require later server permission

name: Review Detail
rules: Approve is disabled until provenance/license gate passes.

name: Publish Confirmation
purpose: Confirm creation of immutable published revision
rules: Publish requires explicit confirmation and creates an immutable revision.

name: Published Revision
rules: Published revision is read-only; edits create a new draft/revision.

name: Interventions
rules: Phase 11/12 domain behavior not implemented in Phase 2

name: Intervention Detail
rules: Recommendation lifecycle layers remain distinct

name: Analytics Overview
rules: Event time/known time/source context required

name: Metric Detail
purpose: Inspect metric definition, cohort and time window
rules: No hidden denominator or future-data leakage

name: Administration
rules: Phase 3/13 define authorization/security

name: Roles & Permissions
rules: UI visibility never substitutes backend authz

name: Audit Log
rules: Privileged actions audited
